title: Settlement Rate Schedule — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans
content:
# Settlement Rate Schedule — Belrose Promotional Financing Plans

The rate at which the interest over the final part of the cycle is priced when a Belrose Promotional Financing Plan is settled depends on what the stretch the repricing review reads shows and on whether automatic payment is in force.

## The schedule

| Where the plan stands | The settlement rate |
|---|---|
| The missed cycles of the stretch reach the term's repricing trigger number of missed payments | The term's penalty rate |
| Automatic payment is in force on the plan and no cycle of the stretch was missed | The term's promotional rate reduced by the term's automatic payment discount, the result rounded to the cent |
| Neither of the above | The term's promotional rate |

The three conditions are read in the order set out: where the missed cycles reach the trigger the penalty rate governs whether or not automatic payment is in force, and the reduced rate is reached only where no cycle at all of the stretch was missed.

## The measure the schedule turns on

A cycle of that stretch in which no payment settled counts as a missed cycle, and the missed cycles are the length of the stretch less the settled payments credited in it, never fewer than none.

*A count worked through (hypothetical inputs).* Where the stretch runs 12 whole calendar months and 9 settled payments are credited inside it, the missed cycles are 12 less 9, that is 3. Where 12 settled payments are credited inside that same stretch, the missed cycles stand at none; and where 14 are credited the count still stands at none rather than falling below it.

## Figures by term

| Term | Repricing trigger, missed payments | Penalty rate | Promotional rate | Automatic payment discount, percentage points |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 12-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 32.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 18-Month Deferred Interest Plan | 2 | 31.24 percent | 0 percent | 0 percent |
| 24-Month Equal Payment Plan | 2 | 30.24 percent | 9.99 percent | 0.25 percent |
| 36-Month Equal Payment Plan | 3 | 29.24 percent | 11.99 percent | 0.5 percent |
| 48-Month Bridal Equal Payment Plan | 3 | 27.24 percent | 12.99 percent | 0.5 percent |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A plan on the 24-Month Equal Payment Plan whose stretch shows 2 missed cycles: the trigger for that term is 2 missed payments, so the settlement rate is that term's penalty rate of 30.24 percent.
- A plan on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan whose stretch shows 2 missed cycles: the trigger for that term is 3, so the penalty rate is not reached; automatic payment not being in force, or a cycle of the stretch having been missed, the settlement rate is that term's promotional rate of 11.99 percent.
- A plan on the 36-Month Equal Payment Plan with automatic payment in force and no cycle of the stretch missed: the settlement rate is 11.99 percent less 0.5 percentage points, that is 11.49 percent.
- A plan on the 6-Month Deferred Interest Plan with automatic payment in force and no cycle missed: that term's automatic payment discount is 0 percentage points, so the settlement rate is its promotional rate of 0 percent.
